# Agenttrail Map

Upstream: https://github.com/sodiumsun/agenttrail, MIT, revision `3785d4ea62ca58b9ded853b2e4c3b99f12c02c97` (0.4.1).

This local copy contains only `bin`, `public` and the original license. The Seneschal-specific optional bridge mode disables local Codex/Claude log readers, other board discovery, repository setup/spawn, and requires a PC-local relay key for the hook. The added `SessionBusy` event reports actual OpenCode busy status without inventing a tool call. The scope folder contains only the architectural plan. This is an optional observability integration, not an agent runner or usage/billing collector. Windows upstream test limitations still apply.
